Hunting Cam, Deer Feeder, and Hunting Stand 125 meters southwest. X-Array at 0 degrees in pine forest. Top soil is consists of wood debris, carbon and clay. Electrodes are installed deeper in order to contact clay soil. Run started on high-low due to high DC on E-W line at 21 mV.
